data.name: Starshot Genesis
data.detailed_description:
Starshot Genesis is a fast-paced first-person space combat arcade shooter. Pilot your ship through 3D space, blast waves of enemies, and survive as long as you can while climbing the leaderboard.

Core gameplay:

Strafe and dodge in full 3D while aiming with the mouse and moving with the WASD, Shift, and Space keys. You start with twin cannons and earn weapon upgrades every 500 points, up to five tiers, so you grow stronger the longer you last. Enemies spawn from portals in packs, using different behaviors: strafers, interceptors, and variants with traits like armored, fast-fire, and elite.

Movement & abilities:

Beyond normal movement you have a Boost (right mouse button) Warp (extra speed when boosting forward, move the mouse to steer your ship), and an Ultimate ability shield overcharge burst on a long cooldown. Shields soak hits and recharge after a delay; health regenerates when you avoid damage long enough.

Goals & challenge:

Survive and maximize your score. Difficulty increases with your score and weapon tier. More enemies, tougher packs. Runs range from a few minutes to long sessions depending on skill.

Soundtrack:

In-game music by Christoffer Moe Ditlevsen / Torque / courtesy of Epidemic Sound with custom sound effects for upgrades, rail cannons, low health, ultimate ready, warp, and kills.

Leaderboard:

Online leaderboard tracks high scores. Scores earned offline stay local.

Controls:

WASD to move, Space/Shift for up/down, mouse to aim, left mouse button to fire, right mouse button to boost. The HUD shows score, health, shield, weapon level, kills, and boost/warp/ultimate status.

data.short_description: Starshot Genesis is a space combat arcade shooter built with Three.js, featuring neon visuals, responsive controls, adaptive combat scaling, and atmospheric audio. Use the controls mapped in the hud to move and engage in combat.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.8 Ghz Quad Core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 470 @ 1GB / ATI® Radeon™ HD 6970 @ 1GB
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: NVIDIA and Intel GPUs are not officially supported hardware.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10.13.6 (High Sierra) or later
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5 (4 Cores) @ 2.3 GHz or Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon HD 5770 or 5870 / AMD Radeon HD 6970M (1GB or 2GB GDDR5)
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: NVIDIA and Intel GPUs are not officially supported hardware.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04 (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: 2.8 Ghz Quad Core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 470 or 570 series
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: NVIDIA and Intel GPUs are not officially supported hardware.
